nodes.description: State array of hardcoded parent addresses (address[]) stored in the addGenesisPairs contract.
State array of hardcoded child addresses (address[]) stored in the addGenesisPairs contract.
Old-style constructor function that fills the newParents/newChildren state arrays and forwards them to the elixor contract.
External interface function declared on the elixor contract; receives the parent and child address arrays.

External call elixorContract.importGenesisPairs(newParents,newChildren) targeting the hardcoded address 0x898bF39cd67658bd63577fB00A2A3571dAecbC53; the callee is an arbitrary/external contract and gains execution control.
Local reference produced by casting the hardcoded constant address 0x898bF39cd67658bd63577fB00A2A3571dAecbC53 to type elixor; used solely as the call target.
Parameter of the declared elixor interface function that receives the parent address array.
Parameter of the declared elixor interface function that receives the child address array.

edges.reason: The constructor body assigns the hardcoded address literal array to the state variable newParents.
The constructor body assigns the hardcoded address literal array to the state variable newChildren.
State array newParents is passed as an argument into the external call to elixor.importGenesisPairs.
State array newChildren is passed as an argument into the external call to elixor.importGenesisPairs.
The local elixor reference built from the hardcoded address is used as the target (callee) of the external call.
Execution of the addGenesisPairs function body reaches the external call to importGenesisPairs as its final statement.

The external call hands control to the implementation behind the hardcoded elixor address, which can execute arbitrary code and re-enter or observe the calling contract; no reentrancy guard or return-value check is present.
The declared parent-address parameter supplies data into the elixor.importGenesisPairs interface function.
The declared child-address parameter supplies data into the elixor.importGenesisPairs interface function.
